notes: Assigned fields only: es_value_o and pval_value_o. N, replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders. Matched by named quantity, not order or numeric matching. Requested individual-quantity test statistic is not printed; alternative printed descriptive AI is retained without conversion. Canonical text contains OCR errors in the numeric table cells. The supplied PDF p.3 was rendered and inspected: the printed anchoring index for this named quantity is .79. Evidence quotes preserve canonical OCR literally. Table 1 reports medians, transformed medians, extreme-value percentages and AI, without quantity-specific p values. The t(102)=7.99, p<.01 on p.1163 compares individual averages across problems for high versus low anchor asymmetry. The t(102)=6.12, p<.001 on p.1164 concerns extreme-estimate frequencies. The p.1165 confidence analyses also test different pooled questions. These statistics cannot be assigned to individual quantity anchoring contrasts. No N derivation or effect-size conversion performed.
